title: Rehti thi ye zainab
body:
rehti thi ye zainab ki sada arze karbala
ay arze karbala
kya thi mere bhai ki khata arze karbala
ay arze karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
do din ke liye hum tere mehman hue thay
kya mehma-nawazi ke ye samaan hue thay
kyun kunba mera pyasa raha arze karbala
ay arze karbala
rehti thi ye zainab ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
mai apne baradar ko kahan dhoondne jaun
apne ali akbar ko kahan dhoondne jaun
kunba mera taraaj hua arze karbala
ay arze karbala
rehti thi ye zainab ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
be dast hue nehr pe abbas e dilawar
dur bali sakina ke chine aur meri chadar
lauta de mere sar ki rida arze karbala
ay arz e karbala
rehti thi ye zainab ki....
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer tadapta raha betaab rahe hum
seene pe tere nehr thi be-aab rahe hum
asghar ke laga teer e jafa arze karbala
ay arze karbala
rehti thi ye zainab ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai tere seene pe ragadta tha aediyan
seene pe sina khake tadapta tha naujawan
jumbish na hui tujhko zara arze karbala
ay arze karbala
rehti thi ye zainab ki…
